name: 630. Older names for the cache-read rate and the per-request fee are read, and the canonical name wins (legacy pricing alias) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7358. Upstream still publishes input_cost_per_token_cache_hit, an older name for cache_read_input_token_cost (41 DeepSeek and Tencent rows), and input_cost_per_request, an older name for the flat per-request fee (four legacy Perplexity rows). Sync dropped both, so a pricing sheet that names a rate only by its older name priced cached tokens at the input rate and dropped the fee. Fixture only: the fixture's pricing sheet carries one row per case, and each row checks the cost the gateway logs for one chat call. 630.1 pins precedence: on a row with both names, the canonical cache_read_input_token_cost wins.
